hooks.command: fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$fp" in .env|*/.env) echo 'BLOCKED: .env is protected. Edit .env.example instead.' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac

fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$fp" in */routes.py|*/models.py|*/app.py) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; dir=$(dirname "$fp"); root=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; common=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir) || exit 0; py="${common%/.git}/venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$py" ] || exit 0; out=$(cd "$root" && FLASK_APP=app.py ENVIRONMENT=testing "$py" -c "from app import create_app; app = create_app('testing'); print('Smoke test OK')" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" | tail -5 >&2; exit 2; }

fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$fp" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; dir=$(dirname "$fp"); common=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; ruff="${common%/.git}/venv/bin/ruff"; [ -x "$ruff" ] || exit 0; out=$("$ruff" check --no-cache "$fp" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
